title: Eloisa : or, A series of original letters
author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
description: Eloisa: or, A series of original letters is the first English translation of Julie, ou La Nouvelle Heloise by the Swiss philosopher Jean-Jacques Rousseau.
longDescription: Explore Alps Region, Epistolary fiction, French fiction, Man-woman relationships, Psychological fiction. This complete source edition preserves the original text and its period language, with the edition credits and licence included.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.

authorInfo.bio: Jean-Jacques Rousseau was a Genevan philosophe, writer, and composer. His political philosophy was influential during the Age of Enlightenment, as well as during the French Revolution.
